name: PT NFC Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT NFC Indonesia Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of marketing platforms in Indonesia. It operates through Digital Product Aggregator, Digital Cloud Advertisement, Clean Energy Products and Services, Digital Wholesale, and Content and Entertainment segments. The company offers various digital products for SMEs, modern retail, and e-commerce through a B2B2C platform; digital cloud marketing ecosystem solution through hardware, content management system and managed service contract; and transportation products and infrastructure under the electric motorcycle Volta brand name.
